newsitem.title: USA: PDVSA cancels four late Aug rfg cargoes due fire.
newsitem.headline: PDVSA cancels four late Aug rfg cargoes due fire.

text.p: Venezuela's state-owned oil company Petroleos de Venezuela (PDVSA) on Wednesday cancelled four reformulated gasoline cargoes, at least one scheduled for delivery to New York Harbor, said a trader, who lost one of the cargoes.
"We were to load (late) August....(and) PDVSA told us they cancelled three other cargoes for second half August," said the trader, adding the cargoes ranged from 260,000 to 300,000 barrels.
The trader said his cargo was due for delivery to New York Harbor, but couldn't say if the other three were also headed that way.
PDVSA declared force majeure on all the output from its Curacao oil refinery in the Caribbean after a fire severely cut output.
